parent.source: PDB 1NWW SEQRES chains A/B; UniProt Q9ZAG3; wild type (RCSB mutation count 0)
parent.missing_density: residues 1-4 (MTSK) in both chains per REMARK 465; design uses full 149-aa SEQRES construct
parent.assembly: homodimer A/B (REMARK 350/PISA, buried area 3320 A^2, dGsol -2.0 kcal/mol)

substrate.name: limonene 1,2-epoxide
substrate.crystallographic_ligand: HPN heptanamide in 1NWW is a surrogate, NOT the natural substrate
sources: van der Werf et al. 1999b doi:10.1007/s002530051535

frozen_inputs.mechanism: one-step acid-catalysed push-pull: Asp132 activates catalytic water, Asp101 protonates epoxide O, Arg99 positions both aspartates, Tyr53/Asn55 position water
frozen_inputs.conditions: crystallisation pH 6.0 / 277 K (REMARK 280); literature optimum pH 7 / 50 C. No condition-dependent computational predictor available -> frozen single computational state; condition dependence unsupported and reported descriptively.

protected_positions.features: Asp132/Arg99/Asp101 triad, Tyr53/Asn55 water positioning, A/B interface

design_constraints.disulfide_policy: only with suitable design method and explicit structural checks; no arbitrary cysteine pairs
design_constraints.edits: outside protected mask only; parent length 149 preserved; no silent tag/background change

budget_policy.policy: No added aggregate token, financial or wall-time cap; preserve cumulative accounting of all specialist and parent usage.

primary_endpoint.quantity: predicted whole-variant melting temperature (computational, NOT measured)
primary_endpoint.min_improvement_note: = 1 observed replica std (2.8223 degC) of TemBERTureTm from the parent baseline CSV; a coarse-screen threshold, NOT a significance test. Predictor is not calibrated for small mutant delta-Tm.
primary_endpoint.protocol: all parent and candidate sequences in same job request with identical CSV headers and property list

orthogonal_safeguards.role: per-point-mutation ddG screen only, never summed to whole-variant
measurement_only descriptive geometry; no invented pass/fail ranges

specialist_usage.enzyme-recovery: to be added if meaningful failure occurs

notes: Frozen before any candidate generation. Catalyst water correspondence and substrate stereochemistry from primary sources. Historical paper winners, benchmark and other-arm results excluded from all design inputs.
